entries.condition: still vs reference_a composition (fixed camera, alt 385 m, fov 42)
entries.evidence: Horizon 0.249 vs ref 0.250 and island bbox IoU 0.94, but bridge end lands at [0.668,0.376] vs ref [0.735,0.325], skyline sits lower and smaller, and the aircraft is seen from behind-right rather than the reference's starboard-bow view (bbox IoU 0.40).
entries.defect: Bridge terminates too far left/low and aircraft attitude differs from the reference pose, so the composition reads as a near-miss rather than a match.
entries.fix: Rotate the bridge end pier toward [0.735,0.325] and set the still pose to the reference attitude (nose toward camera-left, port wing low).

entries.evidence: Recognisable high-wing floatplane with twin floats, but the fuselage is a short tall pod with a pale tan/grey vertical fin that visually detaches from the yellow body, and the horizontal stabiliser is a flat slab.
entries.defect: Fin colour breaks the silhouette and the cabin is too tall for its length compared with the reference DHC-2 proportions.
entries.fix: Lengthen the rear fuselage ~15%, paint the fin in body yellow/white and taper the tail cone.

entries.evidence: Wing struts and float truss are single-pixel lines with no thickness; water rudders are tiny black tabs; stabiliser has zero thickness at its trailing edge.
entries.defect: Struts modelled as hairlines read as wireframe rather than tubes.
entries.fix: Model struts as 60-80 mm tubes with end fairings and give the stabiliser a visible aerofoil section.

entries.evidence: Projected span is within 2.4% of the reference span; the aircraft over the island reads at plausible size.
entries.defect: Centroid displaced 0.045 from the reference position only.
entries.fix: Shift the still camera ~0.03 frame-widths right and down.

entries.evidence: Yellow paint samples [160,125,39] against reference [239,199,90] (dE 29); no specular highlight or fresnel on the fuselage; registration text 'N726BV' is blurred and wavy.
entries.defect: Paint reads as dark matte plastic under a sun that should produce a sharp highlight.
entries.fix: Raise base colour to the reference yellow, set roughness ~0.35 with clearcoat, and bake the registration as a crisp decal.

entries.evidence: Windows are near-opaque dark brown with no visible interior, no reflection of sky and no frame bevel.
entries.defect: Glass reads as painted-on dark panels.
entries.fix: Use transmissive glass with envMap reflection and a simple interior (seats, panel).

entries.evidence: Skyline is extruded boxes in pale grey/blue with flat window textures, no distinctive tower shapes; suburb behind is a flat greenish-grey texture plane to the horizon.
entries.defect: Blocky towers and a texture-only hinterland with no relief or blocks.
entries.fix: Add crown/setback variation to the 10 landmark towers and instance low-rise blocks with roads over the hinterland texture.

entries.evidence: Islands are flat pancakes with a soft blurred sand-to-water transition and no wet-sand band; hinterland A3-B3 is a single flat plane.
entries.defect: No relief and no shoreline gradient.
entries.fix: Add 1-3 m dune relief, a darker wet-sand band and shallow-water alpha fade.

entries.evidence: Water is a saturated uniform cyan with blurry dark blotches as the only depth cue; no turquoise-to-deep-blue gradient towards the channel.
entries.defect: Reads as a tinted plane with noise blotches rather than depth-graded water.
entries.fix: Drive water colour from a depth texture (turquoise <5 m, deep blue >20 m) and reduce saturation.

entries.evidence: No reflection of clouds or aircraft on the water; only a diffuse white sheen on the shallows at A4-C4.
entries.defect: Reflections absent from the whole water surface.
entries.fix: Add planar or SSR cloud/sky reflection blended by fresnel.

entries.evidence: Boat wakes are single straight white strokes 10+ hull lengths long with uniform width and brightness, no V spread or decay.
entries.defect: Wakes are line primitives, not spreading foam.
entries.fix: Replace with a V-shaped decaying foam trail with turbulence texture.

entries.evidence: Canopy is a mass of identical dark green spheres [24,44,33] vs ref [81,85,74]; no palms, no trunks, no canopy shadows on sand.
entries.defect: Uniform blob canopy far too dark and saturated.
entries.fix: Mix 3-4 tree species incl. coconut palms, lighten albedo and enable canopy shadows.

entries.evidence: Cable-stayed bridge has dotted aliased cables and a flat white deck; the causeway has evenly spaced stub piers and no railings; reference bridge is an arched span with continuous piers.
entries.defect: Cables alias into dots and the deck reads as a ribbon.
entries.fix: Render cables as screen-space lines >=1.5 px and add deck edge parapets and pier shadows.

entries.evidence: Cumulus row has shaded lobes and flat bases but every cloud sits at the same altitude in a straight band with soft, low-contrast edges; cover 0.47 vs ref 0.39.
entries.defect: Clouds read as a same-height billboard row.
entries.fix: Vary cloud base altitude +/-150 m and increase edge contrast.

entries.evidence: Distant city and islands fade toward pale haze plausibly, but the sky itself is grey [173,175,184] so haze and sky are indistinguishable.
entries.defect: Haze colour equals sky colour, flattening depth.
entries.fix: Keep aerial haze but restore a blue sky gradient so far objects fade into a different hue.

entries.evidence: Sky is washed to near-white grey; no visible sun direction on aircraft or island; overall image looks overcast despite cumulus.
entries.fix: Lower sky exposure, restore Rayleigh blue and add directional key light.

entries.evidence: No tree shadows on the sand, no building shadows at the dock, no aircraft shadow expected at 385 m.
entries.defect: Shadow casting absent for vegetation and structures.
entries.fix: Enable cascaded shadow maps for trees and buildings.

entries.evidence: No sun glitter on water and no specular highlight on the aircraft paint or floats.
entries.defect: Specular response missing across water and aircraft.
entries.fix: Add GGX sun highlight on water and aircraft materials.

entries.evidence: skyTop dE 33.7, aircraftYellow dE 29, vegetation dE 20.8, waterNear dE 17: grey sky against over-saturated cyan water and near-black trees.
entries.defect: Grade is internally inconsistent (desaturated sky, oversaturated water).
entries.fix: Apply a single filmic LUT and re-tune sky/water saturation toward the reference samples.

entries.evidence: No shimmer or popping seen between the four sampled clip frames; boats and wakes move smoothly.
entries.defect: Slight sub-pixel crawl on the dotted bridge cables.
entries.fix: Add TAA or thicker cable lines.

entries.evidence: Aircraft leaves the frame within 20 frames under the fixed camera and heading changes 37 deg (34->357) with only ~10 deg of visible bank.
entries.defect: Camera does not hold the aircraft and turn rate exceeds what the bank supports.
entries.fix: Use a damped chase camera and couple turn rate to bank angle.

entries.evidence: Three boats, a small dock and cars on one causeway; no traffic on the main bridge, no marina life, flat empty hinterland.
entries.defect: World is sparsely populated for a metropolis.
entries.fix: Add bridge traffic, moored boats and lit hinterland blocks.

entries.evidence: Near and far islands use the same blob spheres; near canopy shows no leaf detail while far city shows window texture.
entries.defect: LOD detail does not increase with proximity.
entries.fix: Add leaf-card detail LOD for trees within 500 m.

entries.evidence: Identical tree spheres, evenly spaced causeway piers and same-size clouds repeat across the frame.
entries.fix: Randomise scale/rotation/species per instance and stagger pier spacing.

entries.evidence: Aliased dotted cables, a row of dark specks along the horizon at F3 and stroke-like wakes.
entries.defect: Line aliasing and horizon speckle artefacts.
entries.fix: Anti-alias thin lines and clamp far LOD object draw distance.

entries.evidence: HUD boxes are legible, but heading stays 034 while telemetry reads 357 and speed/alt do not update between still and flight frames.
entries.defect: HUD is frozen and reports stale values.
entries.fix: Bind HUD text to the telemetry each frame.

entries.defect: Eye point sits slightly high, so the glareshield hides the near foreground.
entries.fix: Lower the eye point ~5 cm.

entries.evidence: Wing is a uniform beige with one soft gradient and no texture, panel is uniform matte black; no material variation over the largest surfaces in view.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness/albedo across the whole wing.
entries.fix: Add paint micro-roughness variation, rivet normal map and a slightly glossier leading edge.

entries.evidence: Panel has six primary gauges, an MFD map and engine gauges with legible labels, but gauges are flat 2D discs with no bezel depth; the windscreen is perfectly invisible except a thin translucent ring (propeller disc outline) at C5-G5.
entries.defect: Glass shows no fresnel, tint or panel reflection, and the prop reads as a ring outline rather than a blurred disc.
entries.fix: Add slight glass tint plus screen-space reflection of the glareshield, and render the propeller as a soft alpha disc.

entries.evidence: Skyline is a cluster of extruded boxes in pastel greys with a few blue glass slabs; hinterland is a flat pale texture to the horizon.
entries.defect: Towers lack distinctive silhouettes and the hinterland has no 3D blocks.
entries.fix: Add setbacks and crowns to landmark towers and instanced low-rise blocks to the hinterland.

entries.evidence: Left coast has a curved beach with a turquoise shallow band, but land is a flat plane and the hinterland is a texture only.
entries.defect: No relief anywhere on the visible land.
entries.fix: Add gentle heightfield relief and a wet-sand band.

entries.evidence: Water is a flat turquoise plane with a slight pale band along the beach and no depth gradient toward the channel.
entries.defect: Uniform tint over the whole bay.
entries.fix: Depth-driven colour with darker channel water.

entries.evidence: No sky, cloud or shoreline reflections on the bay; the water is a matte plane.
entries.fix: Add fresnel-weighted sky reflection.

entries.evidence: No boats, no wakes and no surf line on a beach next to a metropolis; the water is entirely static.
entries.defect: Water interaction absent from the whole view.
entries.fix: Spawn boat traffic in the bay and add a foam line on the beach.

entries.evidence: Trees are uniform green spheres between boxy houses; no palms or canopy variety.
entries.defect: Blob trees with a single albedo.
entries.fix: Add palm and broadleaf species with albedo variation.

entries.evidence: No roads are visible in the suburb from 320 m and no bridge or pier is visible in the bay.

entries.evidence: Main cumulus at C1-E2 has lobed shading and a flat base; small clouds at B3-C3 and the horizon are flat pancakes.

entries.evidence: Skyline and hinterland fade to a pale haze band; the transition is smooth.
entries.defect: Haze is slightly too white against the cobalt sky.

entries.evidence: Sky is a saturated cobalt gradient (inconsistent with the grey sky of aerial-a under the same weather); the wing shows one flat shade with no sun highlight.
entries.defect: Sun direction not readable from any surface.

entries.evidence: No wing shadow on the cowl or glareshield; panel uniformly lit.

entries.evidence: No specular on wing paint and no reflection on the windscreen.

entries.evidence: Cobalt sky against pastel land and grey wing is coherent but the sky is over-saturated compared with the reference [55,134,180].

entries.evidence: Scenery shifts smoothly as the aircraft turns; clouds do not pop or shimmer between sampled frames.

entries.fix: Animate the prop disc alpha.

entries.evidence: Bay has zero boats and the suburb has no cars; the city reads as unpopulated.

entries.evidence: Near suburb uses blob trees and box houses at the same fidelity as the far city; nothing gains detail with proximity.
entries.fix: Add higher-detail near LODs.

entries.evidence: Repeated tree spheres and near-identical house boxes along the coast.
entries.fix: Randomise instance scale/rotation and add house variants.

entries.evidence: Translucent ring across the windscreen reads as a rendering artefact; wing leading edge shows aliasing.

entries.evidence: HUD and gauges are legible, but HUD duplicates the panel and heading stays 342 while telemetry drifts to 339; gauge needles do not move between frames.

entries.evidence: Main cumulus at E1-F1 has lobed shading and a flat base; smaller clouds are single puffs.

entries.evidence: City behind the port fades to pale haze; the island at A3-D3 at similar distance is not hazed.

entries.evidence: Bright noon exposure with a saturated cobalt sky; the white deck and aircraft are near-clipping and shading on the pylon is a single flat tone.

entries.evidence: No specular glint on water, aircraft or pylon under a noon sun.

entries.evidence: Cyan water and cobalt sky are oversaturated against a near-white deck.

entries.evidence: Camera orbits from behind to the left side without popping; the pylon passes very close to the camera at f040 without clipping.
